annotations.title: Add the website to the user's CookiePilot account

description: Adds the website to the confirmed account (setup_token must be ready). Defaults to the website given to create_account. An already added website is returned as is. The free plan includes one website.

hostname.description: Website hostname, e.g. example.com; defaults to the website given to create_account
